description: HumanAIOS specimen-intake Bayesian prior constants, v0.2 per specimen-intake.yml

constants.name: PRIOR_QUALITY
constants.description: Bayesian prior for specimen quality in task performance assessments

trigger.condition: Forecast error on quality > 0.25 for 3+ consecutive cycles

constants.falsifier: After molt window closes: mean quality error > 0.3 OR quality accuracy deteriorates < 70% accuracy
constants.notes: Hypothesis: starting at 0.75 captures baseline expert performer prior. If observed quality consistently beats this, propose increase. If falls below, decrease.

constants.name: PRIOR_ACCEPTANCE
constants.description: Bayesian prior for specimen task acceptance rate

trigger.condition: Observed acceptance rate diverges from prior > 0.15 for 2+ cycles

constants.falsifier: After molt window closes: acceptance prediction error > 0.2 OR actual acceptance rate stays ±0.05 of new prior
constants.notes: RQ2 in specimen-intake.yml uses CredPolicy (resource allocation model) forecasts. This constant anchors the prior for 'will specimen accept the offered task'.

constants.name: SHRINK
constants.description: Shrinkage/regularization factor for Bayesian posterior estimates

trigger.condition: Posterior variance (credible interval width) stays > 0.5 for 3+ cycles (indicates under-shrinkage)

constants.falsifier: After molt window closes: credible interval width does not improve (shrink did not reduce variance) OR overfitting appears (validation error > training error by >0.15)
constants.notes: Controls Bayesian shrinkage: posterior = λ * prior + (1-λ) * observed, where λ = SHRINK. Low values (0.0-0.4) trust data more; high (0.7-1.0) trust prior. Hypothesis: 0.3 balances rapid learning (specimen new) with prior knowledge (expert pool).

constants.name: QUEUE_SCORING_MODE
constants.description: Which formula orders the Priority Queue. 'impact' is the incumbent (score = impact + Σ impact(unblocks)); 'resource' divides that numerator by the row's draw on the binding constraint and bands rows that do not touch the constraint ahead of those that do.

trigger.condition: Open obligations on the constraint unit exceed 4 weeks of declared capacity

constants.falsifier: After the molt window closes: the open-obligation count (outputs/resource_census.json → obligations.open_items) has not fallen, OR the number of rows refused as UNPRICED exceeds the number scheduled — meaning the gate blocks work rather than ordering it.
constants.notes: Q-RBE-01. priority_queue_engine.PriorityQueueEngine.from_constants() reads this and activates resource mode ONLY when current_value == 'resource' AND molt_id is non-null. With molt_id null the engine stays on the incumbent formula, so this row is inert until Z2 signs. See docs/RESOURCE_BASED_ECONOMICS.md §7.

constants.name: CONSTRAINT_UNIT
constants.description: The unit the queue treats as binding. Every work order must price itself in this unit under resource mode.

trigger.condition: Another registered input unit shows higher utilization than the designated constraint for 2 consecutive censuses

constants.falsifier: Two consecutive runs of resource_census_v0_1.py showing a different unit at higher utilization: the designation is wrong and moves to that unit. If utilization of RAT-min falls below 1.0 with backlog flat or falling, Z2 attention is not the constraint and the designation is retired.
constants.notes: Designation is a measurement, not a preference. Mirrored in RESOURCE_UNITS.yaml → constraint.unit; the YAML is canonical for the unit's definition, this constant is what the queue engine reads.

constants.name: SHADOW_PRICE_MIN_N
constants.description: Minimum paired observations before a cross-dimension exchange rate may be recorded as a PRICE event.

trigger.condition: Zero PRICE events recorded for 90 days while substitution decisions are being made informally

constants.falsifier: A PRICE event recorded at n = 8 whose rate moves by more than 2x when re-measured at n = 16: the threshold is too low and the rate was noise.
constants.notes: Enforced in resource_ledger_v0_1.py cmd_price(); a price below this n is refused. Set deliberately low enough to be reachable: an unusable threshold produces no measurements and leaves every trade-off implicit.

constants.name: UNPRICED_ROW_POLICY
constants.description: What the READY gate does with a work order that declares no cost in the constraint unit.
constants.prior_version: PRIORITY_QUEUE.md v1_1 genesis (no cost field exists today)

trigger.condition: More than half of open rows carry no cost vector after resource mode is ratified

constants.falsifier: If rows are priced but the prices are never revised against measured SPEND rows, the gate is producing compliance numbers rather than costs, and REFUSED_TO_START should drop back to WARNED.
constants.notes: Q-RBE-01 proposes moving this to REFUSED_TO_START together with QUEUE_SCORING_MODE. Held at ALLOWED until then so the incumbent gate is unchanged.

metadata.status: READY for build; awaiting Z2 ratification hash for molts
metadata.acceptance_gate: molt_cycle --read-only reports constants: 3 (requirement met when all 3 constants have molt_id signatures)
